info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Routes-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Route Retrieval API provides a streamlined way to access detailed information about shipment routes within the logistics framework. By leveraging this endpoint, users can quickly retrieve route information associated with various shipments, facilitating better tracking and management of logistics operations. This API is particularly useful for logistics managers, operations teams, and developers looking to integrate route data into their applications. Typical use cases include analysis of shipment efficiency and route optimization.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the optimal shipment route based on the provided parameters. Users can expect a detailed response that outlines the most efficient path for their shipments, considering various factors such as location and delivery times.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving shipment route information. The provided JSON object should follow the specified schema to ensure correct processing of the request.

201.description: The route has been created successfully.

ListLogisticsShipmentsRoutesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to shipments and routes.

status.description: Indicates if the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the shipment operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsRoutesResponse_201.description: Response schema for the shipment route operations GET request.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Details related to the audit of the shipment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
